title: Why Phantom Blade Zero Is a Must-Play PS5 Game Before GTA 6
description: In the weeks leading up to the launch of GTA 6, Phantom Blade Zero emerges as an essential PS5 action experience, backed by glowing preview impressions.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Action Game You Need Before GTA 6

While all bets are undoubtedly off once Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) finally hits the market, the weeks leading up to its monumental release offer a rare window for other exceptional titles to shine. For PS5 owners looking to fill that anticipation gap, Phantom Blade Zero is rapidly shaping up to be the game that demands your full attention.

Following a six-hour deep dive into the action title during a recent trip to Beijing, China, gaming media outlet Push Square highlighted the game as one of the most confident and impressive Western debuts from a developer in recent years. Rather than a studio simply finding its footing within the complex action genre, S-GAME appears to be a developer already primed to lead it.

### Outstanding Combat and Encounter Design

During the extended hands-on session, the game’s core mechanics immediately stood out. Key highlights from the preview include:

* **Top-Tier Action Mechanics**: The combat system delivers fluid animations, responsive controls, and a high skill ceiling.
* **Memorable Boss Encounters**: Challenging and meticulously crafted boss fights offer some of the most thrilling moments in modern action gaming.
* **Polished Production Value**: S-GAME's overall execution suggests a studio operating at the top of its game, positioning the title as one of the year's greatest experiences.

### A Worthy Contender in a Busy Window

Although the shadow of GTA 6 looms large over the entire industry, Phantom Blade Zero proves that linear or mission-based action heavyweights can still capture the spotlight through sheer quality. With more insights from the Beijing trip promised for the future, players have plenty of reasons to keep this title on their radar.

## Editor's Take

Phantom Blade Zero proves that incredible action titles can carve out their own space even right before a titan like GTA 6 launches. S-GAME's impressive presentation makes it an essential experience for PS5 players hungry for top-tier combat.
